speaker: Poet (dawn-rite)
question: How does the day begin?
premises: At god's hour, surrender to the Lord; then stillness, restraint, twilight rite.
Two watches of muttering-and-worship, then other session; remainder of time as Śiva's remainder-conduct.
inference: The dawn sequence orders the whole day: surrender first, then stillness, restraint, twilight; two watches given to muttering-and-worship, all remaining time conducted as Śiva's remainder.

speaker: Poet (letter-goddess)
question: Who is enthroned?
premises: A-first-faced, KA-handed, ṬA-footed, PĀ-sided with ṂA-middle.
inference: The letter-body enthroned as goddess: alphabet limbs from A to YA, consciousness-formed Sarasvatī supreme over all.

speaker: Poet (wish-powers)
question: What bears fruit unasked?
premises: Thought-jewel, wish-cow, wish-trees bear fruit — men's desires and no more.
Unasked, unheaped, nourish man's aims, O mother's noble mood.
inference: The wish-powers grant only the wished: unasked, unpiled, let the mother's noble mood nourish man's aims.

speaker: Poet (supreme śakti)
question: Without whom nothing?
premises: Without whom nothing at all is done, nothing known, nothing wanted — by the awareness-lord.
To her, the highest, the worlds' mother — homage to Śivā, Śiva's beloved.
inference: Awareness-lordship as precondition of all doing, knowing, wanting: homage to her as highest, worlds' mother, Śiva's beloved.

speaker: Poet (moonlight)
question: What is asked at moonrise?
premises: Ever-risen, blessed, all-auspicious, Śiva-giving, in-Śiva's-heart-dwelling, O Śivā.
Moonlight opening night-lotus for the worshipping mind: twice-born, make my going in heaven supreme.
inference: Moonlight-prayer for the twice-born mind: opened like night-lotus, made to go supreme in heaven.

speaker: Poet (litany)
question: Who alone is supreme?
premises: Be gracious, all-auspicious Śivā, Śiva's beloved.
Umā, Ramā, Sarasvatī — you alone are the supreme goddess.
inference: Direct address collapsing names into one: Umā, Ramā, Sarasvatī — you alone the supreme goddess.

speaker: Poet (fierce forms)
question: To whom surrender?
premises: O mother, Ambikā, formless, nameless, Umā, Raudrī, Vāmā, Mahālakṣmī, Māyā.
Supreme goddess sporting the five acts, auspicious Bhairavī, glorious — I surrender to you.
inference: Fierce-form litany gathered into surrender: formless, nameless, many-named — five-act-sporting Bhairavī.

speaker: Poet (throbbing)
question: How is she meditated?
premises: Māyā, Vidyā, Mātṛkā, Mālinī — you throb in every body as awareness-spark-self.
How shall I meditate you self-flashing? I meditate you as inward-resounding speech.
inference: Throbbing-in-every-body as the meditation object: self-flashing answered by inward-resounding speech.
uncertainties: Print reads mālini (kept); reference books cite mānini — Tantraloka 15.333 supports mālinī; single surface, no live fork.
